So yes: timeframe 15m, context timeframe 1m, direction SHORT, operator `lte` with threshold 7.5% bearish move (i.e., <= 7.5%). And don’t infer approvals—set an explicit approval flag to ON. 

Can you confirm those fields are being set exactly like that?
